Brick, brass and a long wooden bar.

OBZ Cafe is Observatory’s corner for a flat white at noon, a burger at six and one more round at nine. Pendant lights, framed photographs and a kitchen pass you can watch from your seat.

Order a few pizzas and tapas for the table and pass them around. That’s how we like it.
